description: HR-86 is the designated registration code for the Narnaud sub-division in the Hisar district of Haryana. The office operates as a Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office, primarily managing the registration of private (non-transport) vehicles and issuing driving licenses for the local population.
address: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) Office, Narnaud, District Hisar, Haryana
